hit_rule: Unique highest 1X2 probability or binary probability above 0.5; exact ties reported separately.

comparisons.method: Market midpoints use a common native batch received in the preceding 30s. 1X2 Yes is normalized over three compatible contracts. Totals use the Over midpoint with both directions verified. Closing distance is the squared difference to the conservative fair value under 0–1% exceptional outcomes; each fixture carries equal weight within each family.
